secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL from your Supabase project settings (Settings > API)

secrets.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public key from your Supabase project settings (Settings > API > Project API keys)

secrets.name: STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe publishable key (pk_live_... or pk_test_...) from your Stripe dashboard (Developers > API Keys)

secrets.name: STRIPE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret API key (sk_live_... or sk_test_...) from your Stripe dashboard — needed for backend checkout

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...) from your Stripe dashboard

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth 2.0 Client ID from Google Cloud Console — enables Drive sync and Calendar sync

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID
secrets.description: Cloudflare Zone ID for qslc-hei.com DNS and SSL management

secrets.name: WSDOT_ACCESS_CODE
secrets.description: WSDOT API access code — optional, for traffic/ferry data
